authorization: User: etymologise all Indo-Aryan SIL surveys jointly; do everything; surface tough/unclear cases for audit once done.

proposals.evidence: CDIAL 250 adhika gives additional/exceeding; Platts 35 explicitly supplies abundant, more numerous and much for adhik. The surveyed adhik/odik forms preserve the lexical stem, with initial-vowel variation, aspiration and dental/retroflex spelling qualified. Learned reinforcement or local IA transmission is possible and unresolved. Exact response: odik.
